item.title: APT28 exploits CVE-2026-11111 in the wild against FortiOS appliances
item.dc:creator: Jane Researcher
item.description: We observed APT28 actively exploiting CVE-2026-11111 to deploy Cobalt Strike.
item.content:encoded: We have observed APT28 exploiting CVE-2026-11111 in the wild against internet-facing FortiOS devices. The actor then used Cobalt Strike and T1190 for initial access, followed by T1068.

item.title: Patch Tuesday roundup: 60 vulnerabilities fixed
item.description: Microsoft fixed CVE-2026-22222, CVE-2026-40001, CVE-2026-40002, CVE-2026-40003, CVE-2026-40004, CVE-2026-40005 and more. One was exploited in the wild.
